chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halby, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

A man came to the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and said, 'O Commander of the Faithful! My wife milked from her own breast milk into a drinking cup and gave it to my slave-girl.' He said, 'Inflict pain upon your wife, and it is upon you with your slave-girl.' And this is the ruling of Ali (peace be upon him).

key_terms.مَكُّوكٍ: A small drinking cup or vessel

ai.seo_question: What was the legal ruling of Imam Ali regarding a wife feeding her breast milk to a slave-girl?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) addresses a domestic legal dispute where a wife’s breast milk, transferred via a cup to a slave-girl, establishes a specific kinship or value link. The ruling of 'inflicting pain' (likely a fine or compensation) on the wife and retaining the slave-girl with the husband illustrates the practical application of *radāʿah* (breast-feeding) principles in early Shia jurisprudence, emphasizing that milk transfer can create binding familial or property relations even without direct nursing.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A man came over to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, so he said, ‘O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! My wife milked from her own milk in a drinking cup, so she quenched my slave-girl’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Your wife would be inflicted with pain, and it is upon you with your slave girl. And it is like this in the judgement of Ali<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that once a man came to ’Amir al-Mu’minin, and said, ‘O ’Amir al-Mu’minin, my wife drained her milk in a bowl and made my slave-girl to drink it.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘Make your woman suffer (judicially applicable punishment) and keep your slave- girl’. This is how it is in the judgment of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam.”’
